name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-union-negative-1-p.bal
reason: The case boxes decimal -1.0 in an Employee|string|decimal union and asserts a panic when casting it to byte|Employee. Type definitions, required decimal parameters, numeric literals and unary minus, local variables, calls, and type casts are supported; no stated restriction excludes this union cast or its runtime rejection. The asserted failure of an invalid numeric cast is therefore in scope.
test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts failure at the cast; the case does not assert a particular panic message.
